title: Community Swim Club

services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: We will be offering THREE sessions of swim lessons for this summer season. All swim lessons at Community Swim Club follow the American Red Cross Instructional Learn-to-Swim program. In addition, all lessons are supervised by management and are taught by pool staff with Lifeguard, AED, and First Aid certifications. You will also receive a report card at the end of the session! Designed to provide school-age children and young teens with a positive, developmentally appropriate aquatic learning experience, Red Cross Learn-to-Swim courses consist of a logical, six-level progression. Review the levels document at the bottom of this page to determine the appropriate level for your child(ren). If
